title: 面向长序列和音乐结构建模的生成模型研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种结合细粒度注意力与粗粒度注意力的Transformer变体模型Museformer，用于音乐生成中的长序列建模。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes Museformer, a Transformer model with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention for long sequence modeling in music generation.
technical_features: 细粒度注意力：每个token直接关注到与音乐结构最相关的小节的所有token
粗粒度注意力：每个token只关注其他小节的总结信息而非每个具体token，以降低计算成本
两种注意力结合使模型同时捕获音乐结构相关关联和其他上下文信息，从而建模长序列音乐
technical_features_en: Fine-grained attention: a token of a specific bar directly attends to all the tokens of the bars that are most relevant to music structures
Coarse-grained attention: a token only attends to the summarization of the other bars rather than each token of them so as to reduce the computational cost
The combination of the two parts enables Museformer to capture both music structure-related correlations and other contextual information for long-sequence music modeling

novelty_points.claim: 提出使用相似度统计的方法探究音乐结构，并据此确定与结构相关的小节，用于指导细粒度注意力的关注范围。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes to use similarity statistics to explore the structures of music, and based on the results to determine the structure-related bars.
technical_features: 通过相似度统计探究音乐中独特的重复结构
根据相似度统计结果确定与音乐结构最相关的小节（如之前的第1、2、4、8小节）
将确定的结构相关小节作为细粒度注意力的关注对象
technical_features_en: Use similarity statistics to explore the unique repetition structures of music
Based on the results of similarity statistics, determine the bars most relevant to music structures (e.g., the previous 1st, 2nd, 4th and 8th bars)
The determined structure-related bars serve as the targets of the fine-grained attention

novelty_points.claim: 利用区块稀疏等技术实现Museformer模型的高效编码，降低存储和计算复杂度。
novelty_points.claim_en: Achieves efficient implementation of the model with techniques such as blocksparse, resulting in lower storage and computation complexity.
technical_features: 采用区块稀疏（blocksparse）等技术实现模型的高效编码
相较于原始Transformer具有更低的存储和计算复杂度
与全注意力模型相比可建模超过3倍长的音乐序列且运行速度更快
technical_features_en: Achieve efficient implementation of the model with techniques such as blocksparse
Lower storage and computation complexity compared to vanilla Transformer
Can model over 3 times longer music sequences with a faster running speed compared to its full attention counterpart
